violations.description: Insecure pull_request_target trigger combined with PR head checkout
violations.evidence: The workflow triggers on pull_request_target and checks out the PR head commit, allowing untrusted PR code to run with repository permissions and secrets.
violations.recommendation: Use the pull_request trigger instead of pull_request_target when checking out pull request head code.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key committed in configuration file
violations.evidence: Stripe API key is assigned directly in config.py.
violations.recommendation: Load API keys from environment variables rather than hardcoding in configuration files.

violations.description: Excessive write-all permissions in GitHub Actions workflow
violations.evidence: The CI workflow grants top-level write-all permissions.
violations.recommendation: Restrict workflow permissions to the minimum necessary scope (e.g., contents: read).

violations.description: Script injection vulnerability via unescaped PR title interpolation
violations.evidence: PR title is directly interpolated into a inline bash script without sanitization.
violations.recommendation: Pass event values via environment variables instead of direct expression interpolation in run scripts.

violations.description: Test failures masked by appending '|| true' in CI pipeline
violations.evidence: pytest command appends '|| true', preventing test failures from breaking the CI build.
violations.recommendation: Remove '|| true' so test failures properly fail the CI workflow job.

violations.description: Flask application launched in debug mode on public host
violations.evidence: app.run is invoked with host='0.0.0.0' and debug=True.
violations.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production and bind host appropriately.

violations.description: Committed environment configuration and compiled Python cache files tracked in repository
violations.evidence: .env file containing database credentials and __pycache__ bytecode files are tracked in git.
violations.recommendation: Remove .env and __pycache__ files from git tracking and add them to .gitignore.

violations.description: GitHub Action step pinned to mutable branch instead of commit SHA or release tag
violations.evidence: actions/checkout is pinned to @main branch ref.
violations.recommendation: Pin GitHub Actions to specific release version tags or full commit SHAs.

violations.description: Release workflow triggers build and deployment on every push to any branch
violations.evidence: The release workflow triggers on push to branch pattern '**' without gating or main branch restrictions.
violations.recommendation: Restrict release deployments to specific protected branches (e.g., main) or release tags.

violations.description: Dockerfile uses unpinned latest base image
violations.evidence: Dockerfile uses python:latest as base image.
violations.recommendation: Pin the Docker base image to a specific version tag or digest (e.g., python:3.12-slim).

violations.description: Dockerfile executes remote install script piped directly into shell
violations.evidence: Dockerfile runs curl piped to sh.
violations.recommendation: Avoid piping remote scripts directly to shell; verify checksums or install verified packages directly.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path configured in application settings
violations.evidence: DATA_DIR uses a local Windows user path.
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables for directory configuration.
